description: This file implements a tree transformation to convert if-else blocks into nested if statements within the ANGLE project, specifically rewriting else blocks in shader intermediate representation.

classes.name: ElseBlockRewriter
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to rewrite if-else blocks by transforming else parts into nested if statements.

methods.name: RewriteElseBlocks
methods.description: Main function that applies the rewrite transformation to the AST.

methods.name: visitFunctionDefinition
methods.description: Stores the current function's type context during traversal.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Traverses blocks to find and rewrite if-else statements with false blocks.

methods.name: rewriteIfElse
methods.description: Performs the actual rewriting of an if-else node into nested if statements.
